invalidation.reason: A daily close below the November 20 low breaks the rebound setup. A contract impairment would warrant an earlier review.

objective.condition: A daily close above $7.04 plus a public update confirming Georgia customer acceptance or service.
objective.method: Retest of the $7.91 November 17 earnings-session high. The prior session also reached $7.93.

report.peer_read: AGPU fell the least of the nine. Its published sales multiple conflicts with the same provider’s market cap and revenue, leaving the relative valuation unresolved.

signals.text: On November 17, 2,304 Georgia B300 GPUs were energized and provisioned. Customer acceptance was still underway.
Q3 Access gross margin was 4.58%. Digital-asset gains of $10.48M exceeded reported operating income of $6.83M.
September common shares plus prefunded warrants represented 21.37M economic shares before other instruments.

report.thesis: Georgia’s GPUs have power. Customer acceptance, billing and the cash margin on that work are still the steps that matter for shareholders.
